opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Could I take your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for verification, but the caller's name was not confirmed cleanly, and you then looked up order 639181 when the caller gave 839184, so you should have confirmed the order number before sharing details.

understanding.comment: You captured the caller's issue (the bank dispute) and did not re-ask for information already given, though the order number mismatch should have been clarified.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I can see order 639181, a rug at €110.00.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The order number you read back differs from the one the caller gave (839184), and the statement that the Payments team replies within 2 working days was correct, but the wrong order was referenced.

process_compliance.quote: Bank disputes are handled and by our Payments team, so I've passed your case to them with all the the tails.
process_compliance.comment: You correctly did not handle the chargeback yourself and passed it to the Payments team, who reply within 2 working days, as the policy requires.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it got to that point, I can hear this has been a hassle.
communication.comment: You acknowledged the caller's frustration politely, which meets the communication standard.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the Payments team will reply within 2 working days, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely.
